text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching the Kikuka-sho, Tokai Teio cheers 
on her running classmates.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And Twin Turbo completely burned out. 
Having used up all her strength... she 
collapsed onto the turf right after 
crossing the finish line.
